name: feature-widgets
purpose: The "three ways to start" band of a product page: a centered section title with up to two calls to action, over a bento grid where every cell is an illustration above a bold-led sentence and one affordance — a link button or a copy button that puts a prompt on the clipboard. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'feature-widgets', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `button`, `frame-box`, `bento-grid`, `illustration` and `button-highlight`.
useWhen: To offer the same outcome through two or three entry points (agent, console, terminal), each with its own next step.
avoidWhen: For reasons without an action per cell → use `feature-tiles`.
For a long argument per feature → use `feature-scroll`.
related: bento-grid` — the grid the cells are laid in.
button-highlight` — the copy affordance a cell renders when it carries `copy`.
bestPractices: Give each item exactly one of `action` (a link) or `copy` (text to put on the clipboard).
Keep `copy.text` self-contained; it is what the reader pastes into their agent.
Set `anchor` when a hero button scrolls to this band.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the centered section title as its `h2`, and the accessible name of the band.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: First button under the headline; `{ label, href, trailing? }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: Second, outlined button under the headline; `{ label, href, trailing? }` where `trailing` adds the chevron. Omitted when absent.

props.name: columns
props.doc: Column count of the grid from the medium breakpoint up: `2`, `3` or `4`.

props.name: items
props.doc: The cells, in order; each is `{ title, description, illustration, action?, copy? }` where `action` is `{ label, href }` rendered as an outlined link button and `copy` is `{ label, text }` rendered as a copy button that puts `text` on the clipboard.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import FeatureWidgets from '@aziontech/webkit/feature-widgets'
</script>

<template>
  <FeatureWidgets
    anchor="get-started"
    eyebrow="Get started"
    title="Start where you already work"
    description="The same function, three ways to ship it. Hand it to a coding agent, build it in the Console, or deploy it from the terminal."
    :primary-action="{ label: 'Start for free', href: '/signup' }"
    :secondary-action="{ label: 'Docs', href: '/site/docs', trailing: true }"
    :columns="3"
    :items="[
      {
        title: 'Ask your coding agent',
        description:
          'Connect the Azion MCP servers to Claude Code, Cursor or ChatGPT, and the agent creates, instances and routes the function, with a dry run before every write.',
        illustration: 'deploy-secure-mcp-server',
        copy: {
          label: 'Copy prompt',
          text: 'Create a function that answers 401 when a request has no Authorization header.'
        }
      },
      {
        title: 'Build it in the Console',
        description:
          'Choose the application it runs on, write the handler in the editor, name it, and create it. The rule that runs it is drafted for you.',
        illustration: 'build-applications',
        action: { label: 'Docs', href: '/site/docs' }
      },
      {
        title: 'Ship it from the terminal',
        description:
          'azion init scaffolds from 25 presets, azion dev serves it on localhost:3333, and azion deploy puts it on a live domain.',
        illustration: 'quick-start-with-templates',
        action: { label: 'Docs', href: '/site/docs' }
      }
    ]"
  />
</template>
